digital
數位
Which digital tool would you miss most if you lost your phone for a day?
I would miss my digital calendar most. Writing down the day's appointments beforehand would help me manage without constant access.
我最想念的會是數位行事曆。先把當天的約定寫下來，沒手機也比較好安排。
connect
連接
What would you check when your laptop could not connect to a projector?
I would check the cable before trying to connect again. Testing another port could show whether the problem was the cable or the laptop.
重新連接前，我會先檢查線材。再換個插孔測試，看看是線還是電腦的問題。
web
網路
How do you decide whether information you find on the web is useful?
I compare information on the web with its original source. A recent date and clear evidence matter more than a polished layout.
我會把網路資訊和原始來源比對。日期夠新、證據清楚，比版面漂亮重要。
device
裝置
What would make you replace a device rather than keep using it?
I would replace a device if it no longer met an important need. A slightly newer appearance would not be enough.
裝置已經無法滿足重要需求時，我才會換。只是外觀比較新，還不足以讓我重買。
screen
螢幕
How would you arrange your screen for a video call and note-taking?
I would put the call on one side of the screen and notes on the other. Fewer open windows would reduce distraction.
我會把通話和筆記放在螢幕兩邊。少開一些視窗，也比較不會分心。
keyboard
鍵盤
What would you look for in a keyboard you use every day?
I would choose a keyboard that feels comfortable and is not too noisy. Trying it in person would matter more than its appearance.
我會選打起來舒服、又不太吵的鍵盤。實際試打，比外觀好不好看重要。
code
驗證碼
Someone calls and asks for a code sent to your phone. How would you respond?
I would not share the code with the caller. I would contact the service through a channel I already trusted.
我不會把驗證碼告訴來電的人。我會用自己原本信任的管道，聯絡那項服務確認。
privacy
隱私
What privacy question would you ask before installing a new app?
I would ask what data the app needs and why. A clear privacy explanation would help me decide whether its features were worth using.
安裝前，我會問它需要哪些資料、為什麼需要。清楚的隱私說明，能幫我決定要不要使用。
security
安全
How would you balance convenience and security when signing into a service?
I would accept an extra security step for an important account. Saving a few seconds would not justify exposing sensitive information.
重要帳戶多一道安全步驟，我可以接受。省幾秒鐘，不值得拿敏感資料冒險。
account
帳戶
You receive an unfamiliar alert about your account. What would you do?
I would open the service directly to check my account. I would avoid following an unexpected link in the alert itself.
我會直接開啟原本的服務，檢查帳戶。不從那封陌生提醒裡的連結點進去。
file
檔案
How would you name a file so that a teammate could find it later?
I would give the file a clear project name and date. A version number would help distinguish it from earlier drafts.
我會用清楚的專案名稱和日期命名檔案。再加版本號，方便和舊草稿區分。
document
文件
What would you check before sharing a document with a large group?
I would check the document for private details and editing permissions. The group should receive only the access needed for the task.
分享文件前，我會檢查私人資料和編輯權限。群組只需要拿到完成工作必要的權限。
update
更新
When would you postpone an update, and when would you make time for it?
I might postpone an update during an important call. Afterwards, I would save my work and install it at a suitable time.
重要通話進行中，我可能先延後更新。結束後存好工作，再找適當時間安裝。
software
軟體
How would you choose between two pieces of software for the same task?
I would test each piece of software with a real example. Clear export options and reliable performance would matter more than a long feature list.
我會拿真實的工作試用兩款軟體。能順利匯出、使用穩定，比功能清單很長更重要。
automatic
自動
Which automatic feature would you still want to check occasionally?
I would check automatic backups from time to time. A reassuring setting would mean little if I could not restore an actual file.
我會偶爾檢查自動備份。設定看起來正常還不夠，也要真的能還原檔案。
notify
通知
When should a useful app notify you rather than stay silent?
It should notify me about a change that needs timely action. Routine information can wait until I choose to open the app.
需要及時處理的變動，才值得通知我。一般資訊，可以等我自己打開程式再看。
connection
接駁
Your travel app shows only a few minutes for a train connection. What would you check?
I would check whether the connection required changing platforms. If the transfer looked unrealistic, I would choose a later train.
我會查列車接駁需不需要換月台。如果轉乘時間太勉強，就改搭晚一班。
virtual
虛擬
What would make a virtual museum visit interesting rather than tiring?
A virtual visit would work best with a short guided route. I would rather explore a few objects carefully than click through everything.
虛擬參觀最好有簡短的導覽路線。我寧願仔細看幾件展品，也不想把全部都匆匆點過。
search
搜尋
How would you improve a search that returns too many unrelated results?
I would search with a more specific phrase and relevant place name. Removing vague words could also narrow the results.
我會用更具體的詞句，加上相關地名搜尋。刪掉模糊的用語，也能縮小結果範圍。
source
來源
What would you do when several articles repeat the same surprising story?
I would look for the original source of the story. Repeated copies would not count as several independent confirmations.
我會找故事最初的來源。好幾篇只是互相轉載，不算各自獨立證實。
accurate
準確
How could you check whether an automatic transcript is accurate?
I would compare names and numbers with the recording to check whether the transcript was accurate. Those details can change the meaning significantly.
我會對照錄音裡的人名和數字，檢查逐字稿是否準確。這些細節，可能大幅影響意思。
false
不實
How would you respond after sharing information that turned out to be false?
I would clearly correct the false information in the same group. Quietly deleting it might leave others believing the original message.
我會在原群組清楚更正不實資訊。只悄悄刪除，可能讓別人還相信原本的訊息。
advertisement
廣告
What makes an advertisement useful instead of distracting to you?
An advertisement is useful when it clearly explains a product I actually need. Exaggerated urgency makes me less interested, not more.
廣告如果清楚介紹我真正需要的產品，就有用。誇張地催促下單，反而讓我不想看。
subscribe
訂閱
What would you check before you subscribe to an online service?
Before I subscribe, I would check the renewal price and cancellation process. A free trial would not remove the need to understand those terms.
訂閱前，我會查續訂價格和取消方式。就算能免費試用，也要先弄清楚這些條件。
